steps.name: Marker pass 1
steps.confirm_message: M1 only, marker pass 1: reset the marker and keep the same filled path. After flow settles, introduce the marker without changing the path. Record injection and first outlet breakthrough times relative to actual step start (not this confirmation). Use the same breakthrough criterion for all passes.
